import re,html,json,pathlib
t=pathlib.Path('products/research/community-policies/ghost-forum-guidelines.html').read_text(errors='replace')
s=html.unescape(re.sub(r'<[^>]+>',' ',re.sub(r'(?is)<(script|style).*?</\1>',' ',t)))
s=re.sub(r'\s+',' ',s)
hits=[]
for k in ['AI','artificial','LLM','ChatGPT','generated','bot','automat','promot','advertis','spam','self-promo','commercial']:
  for m in re.finditer(r'\b'+k,s):
    hits.append({'term':k,'context':s[max(0,m.start()-200):m.end()+200]})
out={'source':'https://forum.ghost.org/guidelines','fetch_task':'TASK-179414496114','text_chars':len(s),'hits':hits[:25]}
p=pathlib.Path('products/research/community-policies/ghost-forum-guidelines-extract.json');p.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
p.write_text(json.dumps(out,indent=1))
print(len(s),len(hits));print(json.dumps(hits[:25],indent=0)[:6000])
